subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: One screenshot. 30 seconds. See what your gut was trying to tell you.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, my friend Sarah sent me a screenshot of a text from her boyfriend. It looked innocent. 'You're too sensitive,' he wrote. 'You're imagining things.' She almost believed him. But something in her gut said no. She opened Red Flag Scanner AI, uploaded the screenshot, and within 30 seconds got a toxicity score of 92%. The AI flagged gaslighting patterns she'd missed for months.

That's the thing about red flags—they hide in plain sight. A subtle dig here, a guilt trip there. They pile up until you're drowning in doubt. But you don't need therapy or a detective. You need a second set of eyes that sees what your heart doesn't want to.

Open the app right now. Screenshot any conversation—a text from your partner, a DM from a date, a group chat that feels off. The AI will scan it in seconds and give you a breakdown: manipulation markers, love bombing signs, and a clear toxicity score. No judgment. No bias. Just truth.

Do it now. One screenshot takes 30 seconds. Your future self will thank you.

P.S. The first scan is always free. And if you're scared of what you'll find—that's exactly why you need to look.
